1.0.10.title: Plugin manager: smart uninstall & Windows support
1.0.10.summary: The Plugins page now finds every plugin automatically — VST, VST3, AU, CLAP and AAX on macOS and Windows — and can fully uninstall a plugin, sweeping up presets, preferences, caches and other leftovers.
highlights: Delete any plugin right from the Plugins page — Stack finds its leftovers (presets, preferences, caches, vendor data, even iCloud copies) and shows exactly what will be removed before anything is touched.
Deleting one format offers the others too — remove the VST3 and the AU / VST / AAX copies of the same plugin can go with it.
Files in system folders are removed with a single administrator prompt.
CLAP and AAX plugins are now detected alongside VST, VST3 and AU.
Full Windows support — all standard folders plus the registry-configured VST2 path are scanned, and registry leftovers are cleaned up on uninstall.
Plugin rows now show vendor, size on disk, and which other formats are installed.
No more folder hunting — every standard plugin location is scanned out of the box; extra folders moved to Settings → Plugins.

1.0.9.title: Massive indexing & search speed-up
1.0.9.summary: A ground-up performance pass for huge libraries: indexing is over 15x faster, search runs on a real full-text index, and duplicate samples no longer vanish from your packs.
highlights: Indexing overhaul — a 290GB library with 164,000 files now indexes in about 2 minutes instead of 30+.
Instant search — queries hit a full-text index instead of scanning every entry, so results stay snappy even in six-figure libraries.
Duplicate samples fixed — byte-identical files in different packs each keep their own entry instead of silently replacing each other.
Killed the hidden re-index loop that made Stack re-process thousands of duplicated files on every launch.
Browsing and deep scrolling are dramatically faster thanks to a new sort index.
Lower memory use while indexing — huge DAW project files no longer spike RAM.
Ableton .als project info is now read correctly.

1.0.8.title: Favorites folders & drag-to-organize
1.0.8.summary: Organize your favorites into colorful folders and file samples away with a single drag.
highlights: New Favorites folders — create, rename, and color them right from the Favorites page.
Drag any sample, MIDI, or preset onto a folder (from Browser, MIDI, Presets, or Favorites) to file it away — it's favorited automatically.
Drag multiple selected samples into a folder at once.
Favorites is now expandable in the sidebar, with a live file count on every folder.
Give each folder its own color — pick from the palette or choose any custom color.
Fixed scrolling on the Favorites, MIDI, and Presets pages.

1.0.7.title: Custom themes & window controls
1.0.7.summary: Make Stack yours with custom accent themes and refined window controls.
highlights: Custom themes — set your own accent color across the whole app.
Open samples in your browser for a quick listen.
Custom window controls for a cleaner, more native feel.

1.0.6.title: Auto-play & sticky toolbar
1.0.6.summary: Smoother browsing with continuous playback and a toolbar that stays put.
highlights: Auto-play the next sample as you browse.
Sticky toolbar keeps search and filters in reach while you scroll.
Polished cover editing for packs and folders.
